reserve_profile.summary: RAI is generated against protocol-approved crypto collateral, historically ETH, through Reflexer SAFE positions. Collateralization and liquidation state are protocol-transparent rather than represented by an issuer reserve account.

redemption_profile.settlement_asset: Protocol collateral under SAFE repayment or Global Settlement rules
redemption_profile.eligible_parties: SAFE users and protocol participants subject to available contracts and settlement state.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Stability fees, redemption-rate effects, gas, liquidation, and market costs may apply.

reserve_profile.summary: Paxos states that PAXG is allocated to specific London Good Delivery gold bars and publishes monthly independent attestation reports covering token supply and gold redemption assets.

redemption_profile.settlement_asset: USD, unallocated Loco London gold, or physical London Good Delivery bar
redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Eligible Paxos account holders subject to onboarding, saved account details, quantity, location, and current terms.
redemption_profile.minimum_amount_text: Physical-bar redemption generally requires about 430 PAXG plus fees; other sale and unallocated-gold paths have separate limits.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Creation, destruction, trading, delivery, and other applicable fees depend on the selected path.
redemption_profile.settlement_time_text: London gold-market hours and Paxos processing apply.
jurisdiction_restrictions: Paxos account and jurisdiction eligibility apply.
Physical-bar delivery is limited to eligible UK vault destinations under current guidance.

reserve_profile.summary: TG Commodities states that XAU₮ holders own allocated physical gold identifiable by bar serial number, purity, and weight. Tether Gold publishes reserves reports and independent assurance material.

redemption_profile.settlement_asset: Physical gold or USD proceeds from requested sale of redeemed gold
redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Verified eligible TG Commodities customers holding enough XAU₮ for one or more full bars.
redemption_profile.minimum_amount_text: Full-bar redemption; guidance recommends approximately 430 XAU₮ to cover variable bar size.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Current guidance describes a 25 basis point redemption charge plus delivery or other applicable costs.
redemption_profile.settlement_time_text: Verification, bar reallocation, Swiss delivery, or market sale processing apply.
jurisdiction_restrictions: U.S. persons are prohibited from direct purchase or redemption.
Other prohibited jurisdictions and eligibility restrictions apply.

reserve_profile.summary: SPOT is described as a perpetual note backed by fully collateralized AMPL derivative tranches. Collateral rotates through protocol mechanics rather than remaining in a conventional issuer reserve account.

redemption_profile.settlement_asset: AMPL derivative tranches or protocol-defined collateral output
redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Users interacting with supported SPOT mint, redeem, and bond interfaces subject to current contract state.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Gas, liquidity, tranche, and protocol costs may apply.

reserve_profile.summary: Nuon documentation describes USDC deposits into a treasury and DeFi strategy allocation, with MaxCap acting as a risk-bearing layer. Complete current strategy allocation and capacity require ongoing source review.

redemption_profile.settlement_asset: USDC or protocol/market exit subject to current contracts
redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Eligible users meeting Nuon jurisdiction and interface requirements.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Strategy, staking, wrapping, liquidity, gas, and protocol costs may apply.
redemption_profile.settlement_time_text: Base network and protocol processing apply.
jurisdiction_restrictions: Documentation also identifies UK, China, sanctioned jurisdictions, and other prohibited locations.
